newsitem.title: USA: Muni bond sales total $794 mln for Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Muni bond sales total $794 mln for Tuesday.

text.p: Municipal bond sales for Tuesday are expected to total $794 million in 51 sales, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Negotiated offerings total $441 million in 12 sales, with a $89 million New York State Mortgage Agency deal through Lehman Brothers topping the list.
On the competitive side, 39 sales totaling $352 million are scheduled. A $65 million Wichita, Kan., deal at 1130 EDT is the largest.
An additional 24 sales totaling $1.1 billion are on the possible calender, meaning underwriters have said they may price the issues Tuesday depending on market conditions.
